text.p: General Dynamics Corp bid about $1 billion for military-vehicle producer United Defence LP, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with United Defence's auction.
United Defence is 60 percent-owned by FMC Corp and 40 percent-owned by Harsco.

Other bidders for the company include the closely held Carlyle Group, the paper said in its electronic edition. Alliant Techsystems is also said to have expressed an interest in United Defence, the people told the paper.
An acquisition of United Defence by General Dynamics, however, would face a major anti-trust decision by the Clinton Administration, according to the paper.
That's because if General Dynamics won the bidding, it would become the sole U.S. maker of military tanks, the paper said.
